headline: Giorgetti to the EU: 'Stamp Duty Cut Covered with National Funds.' And Warns on Utility Bills
summary: Italian Economy Minister Giorgetti said at the Eurogroup in Portofino that a stamp duty cut is covered with national funds. He warned that the energy shock will weigh on families and businesses.
why: Italy is the euro area's third-largest economy, and its fiscal choices and energy costs shape its public finances and the outlook for Italian government bonds.
